1. Bookshelf – glass, brown, 5 ft – $204.09

Once the order has been delivered, feel free to reach out again and we can help with the exchange.

I'm afraid cancelling isn't an option either. Orders can only be cancelled while they are still in 'pending' status, and your order #W5362037 is currently 'processed', which means it's already being prepared for shipment.

Unfortunately, at this stage I can't take any actions on the order — neither cancellation, modification, nor exchange. Once the order is delivered, I'd be happy to help you with an exchange or return.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
